description: Grants the main window IPC access while it is displaying the remote https://agiletasker.com origin: the narrow core:event listen/unlisten set (so the web app can subscribe to the daemon-status event this app emits) plus exactly the app-defined commands the web UI drives daemon pairing/supervision through. Deliberately excludes any plugin permission (dialog, shell, updater, ...) beyond what these custom commands wrap internally in Rust — the remote page never gets direct plugin access, only the specific command surface below.
